title: Rare under a model is an anomaly score
hook: Two stated cases: explore the negative log probability under the fitted model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the negative log probability under the fitted model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Nats, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the negative log probability under the fitted model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Low model probability produces a high anomaly score. That score does not establish fraud, danger or even that the model fits the current population. This comparison isolates the negative log probability under the fitted model.
